problem:
$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}^{′}(t)=x(t)+y(t) \\ {y}^{′}(t)=3x(t)+3y(t)\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the system of linear differential equations above. The eigenvalues of the system's matrix are ${\lambda }_{1}=0$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=4,$ for which the corresponding eigenvectors are ${v}_{1}=[-1,\text{ }1]^{T}$ and ${v}_{2}=[1,\text{ }3]^{T},$ respectively. Which of the following could represent the phase portrait of the system?

*Hint: Here, the dotted line represents the equilibrium solutions.*
worked_solution:
The general solution of the system is

$$
x(t)=[\begin{aligned}x(t) \\ y(t)\end{aligned}]={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}{e}^{4t}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\in R.
$$

Let's now sketch the phase portrait.

- First, notice that ${x}_{E}(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ are the equilibrium solutions of the system since ${x}_{E}^{′}(t)=0.$ These solutions form the line with the equation $y=-x$ in the phase space, as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069892/assets/bdfe2e3f89db20665d2c7c1e49c7ddae42387fc1e5bdde8849a9ed1de7e33687.png)

- Now, the line that passes through the origin and is parallel to ${v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3\end{aligned}]$ has the equation 
$y=3x$
and the straight-line solutions of the form
${c}_{2}{e}^{4t}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3\end{aligned}]$
lie on that line. Since ${e}^{4t}\to \infty $ as $t\to \infty ,$ these solutions approach infinity as $t\to \infty .$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069892/assets/99629c2f73e3a10db2ef139848c93c6a2489d995d3d992b7dfb0332989b4f48f.png)

All other non-equilibrium solutions are parallel to the vector ${v}_{2}.$ So, the phase portrait of our system looks as follows:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069892/assets/cb491075c2fecf4aa28f4b167e91ac5a0b7475cf57c1b43eb94e8e1427a28922.png)
